By way of instant petition, petitioner has prayed for grant of bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, in case FIR No.12/2023 dated 10.2.2023,
registered at Police Station, Rekong Peo, District Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh, under Sections 376,
504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Petitioner has prayed for pre-arrest bail on the ground that he is innocent and has committed no offence.
As per petitioner, the prosecutrix, who is 41 years of age, is a divorcee and had consensual relations with the petitioner.
The petitioner is also married and has a daughter.
It is contended on behalf of the petitioner that the 1 Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?

sentences.text: The status report also reveals that the prosecutrix is about 41 years of age.
Even, the complaint submitted by prosecutrix with the Police mentioned that the petitioner had been residing with the prosecutrix for the last about 6-7 months.
It is alleged by the prosecutrix that petitioner had extended her a false promise to marry.

She was not aware that the petitioner was already married.
4.
It is submitted on behalf of learned Additional Advocate General that the petitioner is not entitled for pre-arrest bail as he is accused of commission of serious offence.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is a permanent resident of Village and Post Office, Labrang, Tehsil Pooh, District Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh.
He has roots in Society and there is no likelihood of his absconding or fleeing from the course of justice.

6. I have heard Mr. V.S. Chauhan, learned Senior Advocate, assisted by Mr. O.P. Negi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Rakesh Dhaulta, learned Additional Advocate General for the State.
7.
The contents of complaint submitted by the prosecutrix with the Police reveals that she had not disclosed about the fact of her being married, divorced and having a daughter.
It is also not specifically alleged that right from the beginning of her relationship with petitioner, she had entertained an impression that petitioner would marry her.

It is .
not the allegation that the petitioner from the beginning had extended any false promise to her.
It is yet to be proved that the prosecutrix was not aware about the marital status of the petitioner.
It can be noticed that both belong to the same District and, in any case, prosecutrix could have become aware about the marital status of the petitioner easily.
8. The aforesaid observations have been made only with the purpose to prima facie assess the seriousness and gravity of offence against the petitioner.
9. The case was registered on 10.2.2023.
Petitioner was admitted to interim bail on 13.2.2023.
It is not alleged against the petitioner that he had not joined the investigation thereafter.
It is also not the case of Investigating Agency that the custodial interrogation of the petitioner is imminent in the facts of the case.
It being so, the pre-trial incarceration of the petitioner will not serve any fruitful purpose.
10. Petitioner is a permanent resident of Village and Post Office, Labrang, Tehsil Pooh, District Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh and there is no apprehension of his fleeing from the course of justice.
Nothing is required to be recovered from the petitioner.
Preliminary investigations have already been completed.
Nothing more is required to be discovered by the Investigating Agency which may not be available to them without the custody of the petitioner.

sentences.text:
In the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case, petition is .
allowed.

In the event of arrest of the petitioner in case FIR No.12/2023 dated 10.2.2023, registered at Police Station, Rekong Peo, District Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh, under Sections 376, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, he shall be released on bail, on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer.
Any observations made herein above shall not be taken as an expression of opinion on the merits of the case and the trial Court shall decide the matter uninfluenced by any observations made herein .

above.
